description: Format (pretty-print or minify) a JSON document, optionally sorting object keys. Number literals are preserved exactly (64-bit IDs safe); parse errors report the exact line and column.

indent.description: Indentation: '2' or '4' spaces, 'tab', or 'minify'. Defaults to '2'.

sort_keys.description: Sort object keys alphabetically. Defaults to false.

name: format_json

error.description: "line L, col C: message" on a parse error, or null.

formatted_json.description: The formatted document. Absent when the input was refused.

title: Format a JSON document
